stories.title: Flintshire Council could upgrade its last three public toilets and still face closing them, report warns
stories.summary: Flintshire Council could spend money upgrading its last three public toilets and still face having to close them, a report has warned. stories.title: Wrexham to Bidston trains face cancellation after trackside fire on the Wirral
stories.summary: Trains between Wrexham Central and Bidston could be cancelled or delayed until 5pm today (Friday, October 2) because of a fire next to the track at Upton on the Wirral. stories.title: Garden City: Northern Gateway housing scheme falls short of 20% affordable homes target
stories.summary: Four hundred homes being built at Northern Gateway in Garden City were approved with no affordable housing, a council monitoring report shows. The council’s own policy asks for 20% in the area. The figures are in Flintshire’s third annual monitoring report on its Local Development Plan. stories.title: Flu vaccine kept 800 people out of hospital in Wales last winter
